text:
jonah: Need a tight one-pager + single-slide asset for enterprise launch. Audience: CISO + platform leads. Focus: security posture, SLA guarantees, and which deploy mode to pick. Deadline: next Tue.

alana: Can we frame it around decision criteria? e.g., compliance need -> private, latency SLA -> dedicated, cost efficiency -> hosted. Keep copy punchy.

sanjay: Agree. Include a small benchmark row: hosted p95 ~300ms, dedicated p95 ~110ms, private p95 ~160ms. Call out caching impact: batching + KV cache can halve token cost.

rebecca: Sales needs 3 CTAs: "Request compliance brief", "Get SLA estimate", "Start private trial". Also want a one-line customer quote placeholder.

design-bot: Noted. Will produce a slide with a simple routing diagram (latency vs cost vs compliance axes) and an SLA badge treatment. Need final copy by Mon noon.

ops-bot: Inbound routing recipe: tag = security|compliance -> AE + security SE; tag = latency -> perf team; large-usage -> AE immediate. Template available: https://internal/redwood/templates/inbound-playbook

jonah: Micro-benchmark narrative should include how fallbacks work: if dedicated caps, route to hosted but preserve privacy via token stripping and audit logs. Keep wording non-technical.

sanjay: Add a short tech caveat: model weights consistent across modes; aggressive int8 quantization may slightly affect output quality.

alana: Webinar idea: "SLA-first Inference: How Enterprises Keep LLMs Predictable" 30 min + demo. Good lead magnet. Rebecca can write landing copy.

rebecca: I'll draft email templates: intro, webinar invite, and a short follow-up with a link to the one-pager.

jonah: Asset checklist: 1) One-pager copy (rebecca) 2) Slide + infographic (design) 3) Benchmark PNG + mini prompt set (sanjay) 4) Landing + registration flow (growth) 5) Routing playbook (ops).

design-bot: Acknowledged. Will send two layout variants: corporate and product-forward.

alana: Quick approvals: Sales preview Fri AM, final assets Mon EOD. If all good, publish Tue. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
